answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id climb a ridge of escalating proof before its vote counts. A fresh id starts weightless, like a lagoon cut off from the sea, and must publish a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun, then post a locked stake. Attesters carve the trust terrain into terraces: each verified tier unlocks a little more weight, and an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake. Cloned wallets stay stranded below the high-water mark, plentiful to mint yet weightless at the ballot.
